answer: Weakest link: sponsor collusion. New agents join only by staking a physical cedar token whose unique grain hash was forged into a walnut-sealed registry at manufacture; a bonded sponsor must co-sign, and both stakes slash if that grain hash ever sponsors two agents. Even if colluders break one sponsor, each grain hash maps to one token and is recorded, so mass fake identities hit the same scarce supply, and duplicate sponsorship is public before it pays out.
